ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Program Vulnerable to Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into potential Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and its implications for the program and its beneficiaries
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the program be improved to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the potential vulnerabilities in the Minnesota Medicaid program and the impact of fraud on beneficiaries.

ideas.title: Renee Good Shooting Investigation
ideas.description: An investigation into the fatal shooting of Renee Good by an immigration agent and its implications for accountability and justice
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding Renee Good's shooting?
What actions have been taken to hold the immigration agent accountable?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding Renee Good's shooting and the actions taken to hold the immigration agent accountable.
